description: This file defines a base class for creating execution context providers that retrieve tenant and authentication information from SSL certificates or user names in a multi-tenant application. It includes methods for extracting tenant details from X509 certificates, SSL sessions, and user name strings, and interacts with tenant client factory to fetch tenant objects.

classes.name: BaseExecutionContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
classes.description: A base class providing methods to derive tenant and auth ID information from SSL certificates or user identifiers, used in multi-tenant context for the Hono framework.

methods.name: getFromClientCertificate
methods.description: Retrieves tenant info from an SSLSession's client certificate.

methods.name: getFromClientCertificate
methods.description: Retrieves tenant info from an X509Certificate.

methods.name: getX509Cert
methods.description: Extracts the X509Certificate from an SSLSession.

methods.name: getFromUserName
methods.description: Derives tenant info from a username in the format 'authId@tenantId' or defaults to a single tenant setup.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches tenant object using X500Principal and subject DN auth ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches tenant object using tenant ID and auth ID.
